public.text: The specification assumes a relatively mature national ability to assign identifiers, govern sensitive demographics, operate probabilistic matching, expose high-availability APIs, and coordinate multiple authorities.
public.suggestedRevision: Add progressive maturity levels, beginning with governed identifier cross-referencing and basic matching, then verified demographic services, eventing, advanced matching, and wider foundational-DPI integration.
